Arsenal have three injuries in the squad – Piero Hincapie (ankle), Christos Tzolis (hamstring) and William Saliba (back).

Predicted starting XI:

David Raya; Jurrien Timber, Ezri Konsa, Gabriel, Riccardo Calafiori; Declan Rice, Myles Lewis-Skelly; Bukayo Saka, Martin Odegaard, Noni Madueke; Kai Havertz [...] Bukayo Saka is Arsenal’s leading Premier League scorer this season with three goals [Kirsty Wigglesworth/AP]

## Team news and predicted lineups

### Bayern Munich

Olise is suspended after picking up two yellow cards inside a minute in Bayern’s 3-3 draw with Viking last week.

Goalkeeper Manuel Neuer is doubtful, while midfielder Jamal Musiala is out for a few weeks with a thigh injury.

Predicted starting XI: [...] Bukayo Saka and Declan Rice (Arsenal): Winger Saka is Arsenal’s joint-top scorer this season, alongside Victor Gyokeres, with four goals in all competitions. Rice, on the other hand, leads the chart for the most assists (four).

## Team news

FC Bayern will be missing Michael Olise for the match against Arsenal. The Frenchman is suspended following his sending off in the game against Viking. It’s particularly disappointing given that, since the start of last season, Olise has provided the most shot assists of any player in the Champions League.
